description: Places a REAL phone call: the target number is dialled IMMEDIATELY, both sides are connected through live translation, and the call is charged. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks. interpreter_id and target_number are REQUIRED — never guess either one.

initiator_number.description: Number of the person starting the session.

interpreter_id.description: Interpreter to use. If unknown, call call2me_list_interpreters first.

target_number.description: Number to dial, E.164. The user must supply it explicitly.

name: call2me_start_interpreter_call
title: Start interpreted call
